name: praxflow
description: Lightweight cross-repository governance for product engineering.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-repository interface, verification, and release governance
interface.longDescription: PraxFlow is a narrow agent-neutral Skill for owner-first public interface changes, integrated verification tied to exact repository revisions, and reproducible manifest releases. It intentionally leaves PDF reading, repository discovery, protocol analysis, specification work, implementation, testing, and review to the active agent and companion skills.
defaultPrompt: Use PraxFlow to plan this cross-repository public interface change.
Use PraxFlow to verify this exact multi-repository product revision set.
Use PraxFlow to create a reproducible release manifest from the verified revisions.
